title: Rocket 3 Storm R 2500cc (Classic Heritage)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Triumph Rocket 3 Storm R 2500cc (Classic Heritage) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 2500cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 228 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
